NACHRICHTEN.BESCHREIBUNG: Where and when the bot announces a level-up, and with which message
NACHRICHTEN.MODUS_KANAL_DER_NACHRICHT: In the channel where the XP was earned
NACHRICHTEN.MODUS_HINWEIS: “Channel where the XP was earned” means the voice channel's chat for voice XP and the command's channel for /xp.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAL_HINWEIS: With “channel where the XP was earned” it is the fallback when the XP have no channel.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAELE_FEHLEN: The bot did not answer, so the channel list is missing.
NACHRICHTEN.KANAL_FEHLT: No level channel is selected. Until then there is no level-up message.
NACHRICHTEN.MEILENSTEINE_HINWEIS: Levels separated by commas, for example 5, 10, 25. Jumping past a milestone counts too.
NACHRICHTEN.RANGKARTE: Attach the rank card as an image
NACHRICHTEN.RANGKARTE_HINWEIS: The same card as /rank. Set its look under Image cards.
NACHRICHTEN.GESPEICHERT: Saved. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
NACHRICHTEN.NICHT_EINGERICHTET: Leveling is not set up here yet.
NACHRICHTEN.FALSCHER_KANAL: This channel does not exist on the server.
NACHRICHTEN.MEILENSTEINE_FEHLEN: “Only at milestones” needs at least one level from 1 to 1000.
NACHRICHTEN.FEHLER: Saving failed. The reason is in the dashboard log.
NACHRICHTEN.MELDUNG_TEXT: Level-up messages go to the level channel, and none is selected here. Until then the bot announces no level-up.

VORLAGEN.PH_LEVEL_NAME: Name of the new level (its number if unnamed)

BILDKARTEN.WO_RANGKARTE: With /rank and, if enabled, on the level-up message

EINSTELLEN.NICHT_EINGERICHTET: Leveling is not set up in this guild yet. Turn it off and on again once.
EINSTELLEN.FALSCHE_ROLLE: This role does not exist in the guild.
EINSTELLEN.ROLLE_VERWALTET: This role is managed by an integration; the bot cannot assign it.
EINSTELLEN.ROLLE_ZU_HOCH: Note: the role is above the bot’s role. The bot can only assign it once you move its role above.
EINSTELLEN.FALSCHER_KANAL: This channel does not exist in the guild.
EINSTELLEN.FALSCHER_FAKTOR: The multiplier must be between 0.01 and 100, with at most two decimals.
EINSTELLEN.NICHT_GEFUNDEN: Not found. Please reload the page.
EINSTELLEN.GESPEICHERT: Saved. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
EINSTELLEN.CSV_LEER: The file is empty or has no row with a member and XP.
EINSTELLEN.CSV_ZU_GROSS: The file is too large: at most {{mb}} MB and {{zeilen}} rows.

EINSTELLEN.CSV_ANFUEHRUNG: Row {{zeile}}: a quotation mark is never closed.

XP_REGELN.BESCHREIBUNG: How much XP there is for what, and how often. All values are free; the starting values are only a suggestion.
XP_REGELN.HINWEIS_NACHRICHT: Each message gives a random amount from…to. Within the cooldown only the first message per member counts; 0 means every message counts.
XP_REGELN.HINWEIS_SPRACHE: Each interval (at least 60 s) gives a random amount from…to to everyone listening.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_CHAT: On average {{mittel}} XP per message, at most one every {{takt}} s: up to {{stunde}} XP per hour of writing.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_CHAT_OHNE_TAKT: On average {{mittel}} XP per message, no cooldown: every message counts.
XP_REGELN.WIRKUNG_SPRACHE: On average {{mittel}} XP per interval, that is {{minute}} XP per minute or {{stunde}} XP per hour.
XP_REGELN.MINDESTLAENGE_HINWEIS: Shorter messages do not count. Emoji count as one character; 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.GLEICHE_FENSTER_S_HINWEIS: If someone writes the same text again within this time, it does not count. 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.STORNO_LOESCHEN_MIN_HINWEIS: If a message is deleted within this time, its XP is taken back. 0 turns it off.
XP_REGELN.STORNO_AUTOMOD: Take XP back when automod flags the message
XP_REGELN.STORNO_AUTOMOD_HINWEIS: Only works if automod is on in this guild.
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_MIN_MENSCHEN: Minimum listening people in the channel
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_MIN_MENSCHEN_HINWEIS: Bots and deafened members do not count. With 1 you also get XP alone.
XP_REGELN.SPRACHE_STUMM_HINWEIS: Deafened members never get XP, and there is none in the AFK channel.

STUFEN.BESCHREIBUNG: From how much XP each level applies. Below you see roughly how long that takes.
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_TITEL: Check: what does this mean for members?
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_TEXT: Per level: how many counted messages or how much time in voice it takes, based on the current XP rules.
STUFEN.KONTROLLE_HINWEIS: Multipliers and exclusions are not included. Change the rates under
STUFEN.RATE_CHAT: Chat: on average {{xp}} XP per message, at most one every {{sekunden}} s.
STUFEN.RATE_SPRACHE: Voice: on average {{xp}} XP per minute.
STUFEN.NAME: Name

BELOHNUNGEN.BESCHREIBUNG: Roles that members get, or give back, from a level on.
BELOHNUNGEN.ROLLEN_FEHLEN: The bot is not answering right now. Role names are missing, and new roles are only checked for their form.
BELOHNUNGEN.KEINE_STUFEN: There are no levels yet. Create them under “Levels”.
BELOHNUNGEN.ART_ROLLE_GEBEN_HINWEIS: From this level on the member gets the role. If they drop below (e.g. because XP was reversed), it goes again.
BELOHNUNGEN.ART_ROLLE_NEHMEN_HINWEIS: From this level on Leveling takes back a level role it gave itself. Roles someone gave by hand stay.
BELOHNUNGEN.VORHERIGE: Keep only the roles of the highest level
BELOHNUNGEN.VORHERIGE_HINWEIS: On: with a new reward role, the level roles of lower levels go. Off: they stack.
BELOHNUNGEN.SYNC_HINWEIS: Changes apply at a member’s next level change. For everyone right away: /levels sync in Discord.

AUSSCHLUESSE.BESCHREIBUNG: Where and for whom there is no XP, XP only in certain channels, or more and less.
AUSSCHLUESSE.BOT_FEHLT: The bot is not answering right now. Names and the per-channel count are missing.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ZAEHLUNG_HINWEIS: Counted by the channel rules. Role rules act per member and are not included here.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_AUSSCHLIESSEN_HINWEIS: No XP here or with this role. Comes before all other rules; for channels also covers threads.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_NUR_HINWEIS: Once such a rule exists, there is XP only there (channels and roles separately): with “only here” for a category, all other channels stop counting.
AUSSCHLUESSE.WIRKUNG_FAKTOR_HINWEIS: More or less XP, e.g. 2 = double, 0.5 = half. For channels the most specific rule applies (channel before category), for roles the highest multiplier; both are multiplied.
AUSSCHLUESSE.LEER_TEXT: XP everywhere, the same for everyone.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ANGELEGT: Rule added. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
AUSSCHLUESSE.ENTFERNT: Rule removed. The bot picks it up within 30 seconds.
AUSSCHLUESSE.REIHENFOLGE: Order in the bot: “no XP” first, then “only here”, then multipliers.

RANGLISTE.BESCHREIBUNG: Who has the most XP, overall, this week and this month.
RANGLISTE.LEER_TEXT: Nobody has earned XP in this period yet.
RANGLISTE.SEITE_LEER_TEXT: There are not that many places. Go back to the first page.
RANGLISTE.KEIN_PLATZ: You have no XP in this period yet.
RANGLISTE.HINWEIS_GESAMT: All time sorts by prestige, then XP. Equal XP share the same place.
RANGLISTE.HINWEIS_WOCHE: Counts XP since Monday 00:00 (German time). The level is the current one. Revoked XP and prestige do not count.
RANGLISTE.HINWEIS_MONAT: Counts XP since the first of the month, 00:00 (German time). The level is the current one. Revoked XP and prestige do not count.

DATEN.BESCHREIBUNG: Export and import levels, set retention, reset everything.
DATEN.GESPERRT: In the control guild only the owner can change anything here. Export and recount work.
DATEN.NUR_LESEN: Importing, changing retention and resetting need the permission “Reset leveling data”.
DATEN.EXPORT_TEXT: You can import the levels file here again (“set”), so it also works as a backup.
DATEN.EXPORT_SPALTEN: Levels: mitglied_id, xp, level, prestige, nachrichten, sprachminuten. Entries: every XP award with time, source, actor and reason. Comma separated, UTF-8.
DATEN.EXPORT_FEHLER: The export failed. Please try again.
DATEN.NACHRECHNEN_TEXT: Checks that every level equals the sum of its entries. Changes nothing.
DATEN.NACHRECHNEN_ABWEICHUNG: {{n}} of {{geprueft}} levels differ from their entries:
DATEN.VERLASSEN_TEXT: What happens to XP, history and counters when someone leaves the guild. If the member returns before the period ends, everything stays. Deletion runs at night.
DATEN.VERLASSEN_GRENZE: Applies to everyone who leaves from now on. If the bot is offline when someone leaves, their level stays. 0 days = next night.
DATEN.VERLASSEN_LOESCHEN_GESPEICHERT: Saved: XP is deleted {{tage}} days after leaving.
DATEN.VERLASSEN_BEHALTEN_GESPEICHERT: Saved: XP is kept when leaving.
DATEN.VERDICHTUNG_TEXT: Entries older than {{tage}} days are summarised into monthly totals per member at night. The level stays the same. Weekly and monthly leaderboards and revoking XP when a message is deleted therefore reach back at most that far. The operator sets this period.
DATEN.VERDICHTUNG_UNBEKANNT: The period for summarising old entries cannot be read right now.
DATEN.IMPORT_TEXT: Levels from another bot: export them there as CSV and import them here. Each row needs the member’s Discord ID and their XP. The file is checked first; nothing is written until you click “Import”.
DATEN.IMPORT_SPALTEN: Without a header: first column ID, second column XP. With a header, recognised: ID from {{id}}; XP from {{xp}}. Separator comma, semicolon or tab.
DATEN.MODUS_SETZEN_TEXT: The level becomes exactly the value in the file. For moving from another bot and restoring a backup. Importing again changes nothing.
DATEN.MODUS_ADDIEREN_TEXT: The value is added to the level. The same file only counts once.
DATEN.IMPORT_NACHHER: Importing sends no level-up messages. Run /levels sync afterwards to hand out reward roles. Every change is an entry with source “import” and your name in the history.
DATEN.IMPORT_ERGEBNIS: {{zeilen}} rows read: {{aendern}} levels change ({{neu}} new members), {{gleich}} stay the same. Total of these members before {{vorher}} XP, after {{nachher}} XP.
DATEN.IMPORT_SCHON: {{n}} rows of this file were already imported and are skipped.
DATEN.IMPORT_NICHTS: Nothing to do: all levels already match.
DATEN.IMPORT_FERTIG: Imported: {{gebucht}} levels changed, {{doppelt}} were already there. Run /levels sync now for the reward roles.
DATEN.IMPORT_ABGEBROCHEN: Stopped after {{gebucht}} changes: {{grund}}. What was written stays. “Import” continues from there.
DATEN.IMPORT_ZU_GROSS: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
DATEN.IMPORT_ZEILENFEHLER: {{n}} rows have errors. Nothing was imported.
DATEN.ZEILE_ID_FALSCH: Row {{zeile}}: this is not a Discord ID (17 to 20 digits).
DATEN.ZEILE_XP_KEINE_ZAHL: Row {{zeile}}: XP must be a whole number.
DATEN.ZEILE_DOPPELT: Row {{zeile}}: this member is already in row {{erste}}.
DATEN.ZEILE_XP_ZU_GROSS: Row {{zeile}}: the XP value is too large.
DATEN.ZURUECK_TEXT: All members start again at 0 XP.
DATEN.ZURUECK_PUNKT_WEG: Gone: all levels, the whole history, season standings and counters.
DATEN.ZURUECK_PUNKT_BLEIBT: Kept: levels table, XP rules, exclusions, rewards and messages.
DATEN.ZURUECK_PUNKT_ROLLEN: Run /levels sync afterwards to remove reward roles.
DATEN.ZURUECK_PUNKT_EXPORT: Export the levels first if you want to keep them.
DATEN.ZURUECK_MODAL_NAME: All XP in “{{name}}” will be deleted.
DATEN.ZURUECK_EINTIPPEN: To confirm, type the guild name:
DATEN.ZURUECK_PROBE_FEHLER: Counting failed, nothing will be reset:
DATEN.ZURUECK_NAME_FALSCH: The name does not match, nothing was reset. Expected: {{name}}
DATEN.ZURUECK_FERTIG: Reset: {{mitglieder}} levels and {{buchungen}} entries deleted. Run /levels sync now for the reward roles.
